action.command: cd /workspace && echo "---WORKER---"; ps aux | grep -E "background-worker|websocket-server|dartsass" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $11,$12,$13,$14}'; echo "---PORT3000---"; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":3000|:6042|:9200|:6379|:5432"; echo "---DB TABLES---"; PGPASSWORD=zammad psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U zammad -d zammad_development -tAc "select count(*) from pg_tables where schemaname='public';" 2>&1; echo "---USERS---"; PGPASSWORD=zammad psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U zammad -d zammad_development -tAc "select id,login,email from users limit 5;" 2>&1
